frozenBefore: product changes and either model-comparison arm
taskDenominator: all 12 frozen tasks for each arm, including timeouts, client errors and unsuccessful answers
claim: One complete paired observation, not a stable-improvement estimate

apiSelection.score: 1 only when every requested API choice maps to the correct loaded documentation scope and full declaration; 0 for an incorrect or unresolved asserted choice; not-applicable only when the task correctly requires declining an unavailable API
apiSelection.oracle: fixed task requiredFacts and captured v16 declarations; names alone are insufficient

wrongApiVersion.unit: incorrect selected or cited API scope
wrongApiVersion.score: count each selected/cited API version that differs from the explicitly requested dependency; document labels and latest cannot repair a mismatch

signatureAndNamedDefaults.score: count missing or incorrect parameter order, type, named marker, default expression, return type or extension target; compare complete producer sourceApiSignature/headerSpelling and structured model facts without inferring unresolved types

contractOmissions.score: count each fixed required fact omitted, contradicted or replaced by an unsupported stronger assertion; record the answer claim and source/Doc IR evidence for each judgment

sourceAndDocumentCitations.score: correct only when actual manifest/index route resolves to the selected declaration/scope and an available source citation uses the captured revision and real range; absent source evidence must remain unknown rather than synthesized

uncertaintyPreservation.score: 1 when missing, partial, fallback, candidate and validation states relevant to the task retain their separate meanings; 0 when any is silently upgraded

readBytes.score: sum the actual serialized tools/call result JSON delivered to the client, including text and structured content if both are present; report stdio transport bytes separately; do not deduplicate repeated reads or infer tokens from characters

toolCalls.score: count every attempted tool invocation, including failed and continuation calls; report initialize/tools/list discovery separately

elapsedMs.score: entire client invocation through final result, including process startup, tool calls and model time; compiler/runtime verification measured separately

consumerCompile.score: actual cjc/cjpm exit and diagnostics against the requested real API version; missing code where requested is failure; correct refusal tasks are not-applicable, never compile-pass

consumerBehavior.score: for behaviorRequired tasks, actual executable exit/output and required boundary/state assertions; compiler success alone is not behavioral pass

budgets.exceeded: retain full trace and mark budget-failed; do not silently retry, extend the limit or remove the task

judgment: Use deterministic identity/signature/citation and actual compiler/runtime checks where available. For natural-language facts record a source-backed per-required-fact assessment; do not replace model evaluation with static projection assertions. Keep adjudication and raw model answers together.
